findings.motion: Second Reading, S747 Elections Law Changes (House roll call H-542, 69 to 47)
findings.note: Roll call lists Wheatley among the Ayes. S747 is an omnibus election bill. Its enacted text (Session Law 2023-140) refers to photo identification under G.S. 163-166.16, photocopy of ID or an affidavit with absentee ballots, and driver license or ID card numbers on absentee ballot requests. It also covers other election administration changes.

findings.motion: Veto Override, S747 Elections Law Changes (House roll call H-596, 72 to 44)
findings.note: Roll call lists Wheatley among the Ayes on the vote to override the governor's veto of S747. The bill became Session Law 2023-140. It is an omnibus election bill that touches photo ID, absentee ballot ID, and other election rules.

findings.motion: Third Reading, SB 921 Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters (House roll call #810, 73 ayes, 45 noes)
findings.note: House third-reading vote on SB 921, a state constitutional amendment requiring photo ID for all voters. The roll call transcript lists Diane Wheatley among the ayes. The bill became SL 2024-58.
